name: Aoto Mikamo
source:
Mikamo is the protagonist's kouhai who has a knack for attracting misfortune, which coupled with her clumsiness means that she often causes all sorts of accidents. However, she refuses to let this make her upset and always tries her best to be energetic. She’s a member of the discipline committee although she always causes trouble for them too. This makes her seem like a lost puppy, which makes the protagonist just want to give her a hug.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/20/previewstrawberry-nauts/]Liemyx's preview[/url]]
